description: This file is a test script that analyzes other Python source files within the 'litellm/router_strategy' directory to ensure that cache-related calls within async functions are properly designated as async calls. It defines an AST visitor class to identify cache calls inside async functions, traverses relevant files, and asserts that cache calls in async functions are made asynchronously.

classes.name: AsyncCacheCallVisitor
classes.description: An AST NodeVisitor that tracks cache-related function calls within async functions by traversing the syntax tree and recording calls with their line numbers.

methods.name: visit_AsyncFunctionDef(self, node)
methods.description: Handles async function definitions, records the function name, and prepares to collect cache calls within it.

methods.name: visit_Call(self, node)
methods.description: Inspects function call nodes; if within an async function and the call involves cache-related method names, records the call and line number.

methods.name: List[str] get_python_files(directory: str)
methods.description: Retrieves all Python files within a specified directory, excluding special files like '__init__.py'.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[Tuple[str,int]]] analyze_file(file_path: str)
methods.description: Parses a Python file into an AST and uses the visitor to collect cache calls in async functions.

methods.name: test_router_strategy_async_cache_calls()
methods.description: Main test function that scans the target directory, analyzes each file, and asserts that cache calls in async functions are properly marked as async.
